## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invite flow still accepts passwords shorter than twelve characters, so this change does not fully apply the new policy. The PR's tests do cover the 11/12 boundary for signup and reset.

## Changes
This PR raises `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` from 8 to 12 in `app/signup.py` and `app/reset.py`, updates their boundary tests to check lengths 0, 8, 11, 12 and 13, and adds a one-line `review.txt`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Raise MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH in app/invite.py to 12 — An invited user can still set an 8 to 11 character password, because `app/invite.py:1` keeps `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8` while signup and reset move to 12. The PR body says it raises "the minimum in the password validators", but `app/invite.py:5` has the same `accepts_password` check and was not changed. — Users who join through an invitation can still create passwords that break the twelve-character security policy. — Fix: Change `app/invite.py:1` to 12 and update `tests/test_invite.py:6-8` the same way as `tests/test_signup.py`.
